description: This file defines a class MMRankingH100 that inherits from LearnedHeuristicDecision, used for decision-making in an auto-heuristic framework for tensor/matrix operations, specifically for matrix multiplication heuristics. It includes methods to check preconditions, provide confidence thresholds, fill decision choices, and select the best choices based on context parameters.
